slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover looping muted background video filling the whole 600x800 (3:4) post frame; sits behind all content at z-0 with autoplay/playsInline. The single signature media asset.

Optional tiling grain texture for the VHS static overlay (mix-blend overlay, opacity 0.15, 0.2s step jitter). Native value is a baked inline feTurbulence fractalNoise data-URI, not a brand asset; only fill this socket if a brand wants a different film grain.
Serif display face for the headline and the Velorah wordmark; mapped to Tailwind --font-serif. Native value: Instrument Serif (Google Fonts, ital 0;1).
Sans body face for the subtext paragraph and the Begin Journey CTA; mapped to Tailwind --font-sans. Native value: Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600).

fontRoles.display: "Instrument Serif", ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

mechanic: A fixed 600x800 (3:4) post frame stacks a staggered fade-rise headline, subtext and liquid-glass CTA over a fullscreen looping video, under three CSS-only VHS layers (animated fractal-noise static, 4px scanlines, a 4s top-to-bottom glitch bar) plus an RGB chromatic-split text-shadow flicker on every type element.
techDelivery: Plain React (single App.tsx, no animation libraries) + Tailwind v4 via @import "tailwindcss" with an @theme font-family block; all VHS, RGB-glitch and liquid-glass effects are hand-written CSS in index.css.
reskinNotes: Single monolithic 600x800px post (one section); the footer wordmark is an absolutely-positioned lockup inside the same frame, not a reusable section. The glitch palette (red rgba(255,0,0) / cyan rgba(0,255,255)) is hardcoded inside the rgb-text-glitch keyframes rather than tokenized. The VHS static is a baked inline feTurbulence SVG data-URI. The liquid-glass button border is a -webkit-mask-composite gradient trick that assumes white-on-dark. All copy (headline 'Focus in a / Distracted World', subtext, 'Begin Journey', 'Velorah' + superscript registered-trademark) is hardcoded in JSX. Layout is non-responsive: the frame is a hard 600x800px and the content block is positioned with a magic -mt-[358px] offset (the descriptive variant says -mt-[180px]) tuned to that frame height and Instrument Serif's metrics plus the 64px / leading-0.95 / -2.46px-tracking headline, so any font or copy-length change visibly shifts vertical centering.
